seo.title: Stockroom: inventory sync for small online stores
seo.description: Stockroom keeps stock counts in sync across your online store, marketplace listings and the shelf, so you stop selling things you don't have.

props.headline: Stop selling the last one twice
props.subheadline: Stockroom keeps one stock count for your store, your marketplace listings and the shelf. When something sells anywhere, every channel updates within seconds.

media.alt: Stockroom dashboard listing products with stock counts per channel and a low-stock warning

props.heading: Connects the channels small stores actually use
One number per product, everywhere
props.intro: Stockroom sits between your channels. It doesn't replace your store; it stops the store and the marketplace from disagreeing.

items.title: Two-way sync
items.text: A sale on any channel lowers the count on all the others. A restock you enter once shows up everywhere.

items.title: Seconds, not hours
items.text: Updates arrive from each channel's webhooks, with a scheduled re-check every 15 minutes in case one is missed.

items.title: Safety buffer
items.text: Hold back a few units per channel so a slow marketplace update can't oversell your last item.

items.title: Bundles and variants
items.text: Sell a gift box made of three products and Stockroom lowers each one. Sizes and colours are tracked separately.

items.title: Low-stock alerts
items.text: Get an email or chat message when a product drops below the level you set, with the last 30 days of sales next to it.

items.title: A history you can read
items.text: Every change records where it came from: an order, a manual edit, a return. Handy when the numbers look wrong.

props.heading: Priced by products, not by sales
props.intro: Every plan includes all channels and features. Pick the one that fits your catalogue.
props.note: 14-day trial on every plan, no card required. Cancel from the settings page.

props.heading: Start your 14-day trial
props.text: Leave your email and we'll send the link to connect your first channel. No card needed.
props.successMessage: Check your inbox for the setup link. It takes about five minutes to connect your first channel.

items.question: What happens if a channel is down?
items.answer: Stockroom queues the update and retries. If a channel stays unreachable for more than 30 minutes, you get an alert and the dashboard marks which counts may be out of date.

items.question: Do I have to move my products into Stockroom?
items.answer: No. Connect your store and Stockroom imports the catalogue. Products stay where they are; Stockroom only manages the stock numbers.

items.question: Can I try it on part of my catalogue first?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose which products Stockroom manages and leave the rest alone until you're comfortable.

props.headline: Try it on your real catalogue for two weeks
props.text: Connect a channel in about five minutes. No card needed for the trial.
